description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the number of datasets over time, categorized by geographic origin or affiliation. The horizontal axis represents the "Year," displaying discrete chronological categories from 2012 to 2022. The vertical axis, labeled "Number of datasets," utilizes a logarithmic scale (base 10) ranging from $10^0$ to $10^2$, with major horizontal grid lines and tick labels placed at intervals of $10^0$, $10^1$, and $10^2$. The data is represented by vertical bars grouped by year, with each group containing up to six side-by-side bars corresponding to different categories as defined by the legend: "Other" (blue), "USA" (orange), "IN" (green), "UK" (red), "IT" (purple), and "DE" (brown). The values vary across the chart; the shortest visible bars align with the $10^0$ (1) baseline, such as the USA in 2014, DE in 2015, IN in 2017, and IT in 2022, while the tallest single bar represents the "Other" category in 2021, reaching an approximate value slightly above $10^2$ (100). The bar groups are sorted chronologically from left to right along the horizontal axis. Visually, the bars for the final year, 2022, are emphasized by being rendered in lighter, faded shades of their respective category colors, contrasting with the solid, opaque colors used for all preceding years from 2012 to 2021.
